title: Library loans with due dates and fines
prompt:
Build a library loans system in Python as a package library/ with library/__init__.py, library/errors.py, library/catalog.py and library/loans.py.
- library/errors.py: class LoanError(Exception).
- library/catalog.py: class Catalog with add_book(isbn, title, copies=1) (adding an existing isbn adds to its copies), title(isbn), available(isbn) -> copies not on loan (an unknown isbn raises KeyError).
- library/loans.py: class Library(catalog) with add_member(member_id, name); checkout(member_id, isbn, day) -> the due date, 14 days after day (day is a datetime.date). It raises LoanError when no copy is available, when the member already has 3 books, when the member already has this isbn, or when the member owes more than 500 cents in fines; an unknown member or isbn raises KeyError. return_book(member_id, isbn, day) -> the fine in cents for this return: 25 cents per day after the due date (0 if on time), added to what the member owes; LoanError if they do not have that book. loans(member_id) -> a list of (isbn, due_date) sorted by due date then isbn. owed(member_id) -> cents. pay(member_id, cents) lowers what they owe (never below 0) and returns what is still owed. overdue(day) -> a list of (member_id, isbn, days_late) for loans past due on that day, sorted by member then isbn.
Write unit tests too.
